application.name: OptiDeli
application.description: Transport management: orders, dispatch, trip execution, yard and freight audit.

capabilities.name: Enterprise logistics
capabilities.description: Rate cards, tenders, load optimizer, telematics, ESG and EDI.

permissions.name: Access: access.role.manage
permissions.description: Create, change and delete custom roles

permissions.name: Access: access.role.view
permissions.description: View roles and permissions

permissions.name: Access: access.user.manage
permissions.description: Assign roles to members

permissions.name: Contracts: attendance.manage
permissions.description: Record the attendance of contracted vehicles

permissions.name: Billing and reports: billing.issue
permissions.description: See what is ready to bill, issue customer invoices from verified charges and cancel a billing run

permissions.name: Driver cash: cash.approve
permissions.description: Approve or reject driver cash requests up to the approval limit

permissions.name: Driver cash: cash.approve.large
permissions.description: Approve driver cash requests above the approval limit

permissions.name: Driver cash: cash.disburse
permissions.description: Pay approved driver cash out of a cashbox

permissions.name: Driver cash: cash.manage
permissions.description: Manage cashboxes, top them up and set the approval limit

permissions.name: Driver cash: cash.request
permissions.description: Request driver cash (uang jalan) for a trip and cancel requests

permissions.name: Driver cash: cash.settle
permissions.description: Settle driver cash with the actual spending and receipts

permissions.name: Driver cash: cash.view
permissions.description: View driver cash vouchers, cashboxes and balances

permissions.name: Contracts: contract.manage
permissions.description: Manage fixed-cost vehicle contracts and run their months

permissions.name: Billing and reports: cost.verify
permissions.description: Verify or reject the buying charges of an SPM and record the vendor bill per SPM

permissions.name: Customer portal: customer.portal
permissions.description: Use the customer portal (requires a customer-bound membership)

permissions.name: Customer portal: customer.portal.provision
permissions.description: Provision customer portal accounts and manage API clients and webhooks

permissions.name: Cut-over: cutover.approve
permissions.description: Approve the cut-over gate (Gerbang C) or roll a cut-over back

permissions.name: Cut-over: cutover.manage
permissions.description: Manage cut-over trackers, their checklist and the legacy control totals

permissions.name: Dispatch approval: dispatch.approve.level1
permissions.description: Approve a dispatch plan below the margin guardrail (level 1)

permissions.name: Dispatch approval: dispatch.approve.level2
permissions.description: Approve a dispatch plan at margin level 2

permissions.name: Dispatch approval: dispatch.approve.level3
permissions.description: Approve a dispatch plan at margin level 3 (critical)

permissions.name: Operations: enterprise.manage
permissions.description: Use rate cards, tenders, telematics, ESG, EDI and accounting sync actions

permissions.name: Operations: execution.verify
permissions.description: Verify proof of delivery and operational evidence

permissions.name: Finance: finance.access
permissions.description: Register and review freight invoices and accessorial evidence

permissions.name: Finance: freight.approve.cfo
permissions.description: Approve CFO-tier freight invoices

permissions.name: Finance: freight.approve.finance
permissions.description: Approve freight invoices at the Finance tier

permissions.name: Finance: freight.approve.finance_supervisor
permissions.description: Approve dual-tier freight invoices as Finance Supervisor

permissions.name: Finance: freight.approve.logistics_manager
permissions.description: Approve dual-tier freight invoices as Logistics Manager

permissions.name: Finance: freight.escalation.resolve
permissions.description: Resolve critical freight escalations

permissions.name: Master data: master.manage
permissions.description: Create and change master data: customers, projects, locations, regions, carrier types, goods, services and charge codes

permissions.name: Operations: operations.manage
permissions.description: Create and progress orders, dispatch plans, fleet, trips, yard and vendors

permissions.name: Operations: operations.view
permissions.description: View orders, dispatch, fleet, trips, yard, vendors, freight and enterprise data

permissions.name: Commercial: policy.manage
permissions.description: Change the margin policy

permissions.name: Tariffs: rate.approve
permissions.description: Approve or retire tariffs (never your own draft)

permissions.name: Tariffs: rate.buy.view
permissions.description: View buying tariffs, markups and margins

permissions.name: Tariffs: rate.manage
permissions.description: Draft tariffs, tariff lines and markup rules

permissions.name: Tariffs: rate.view
permissions.description: View selling tariffs and test the tariff resolver

permissions.name: Billing and reports: report.pnl.view
permissions.description: View the contribution profit and loss by SPM, customer, project, vehicle, vendor and lane

permissions.name: Billing and reports: selling.verify
permissions.description: Verify or reject the selling charges of a delivered SPM (never ones you made yourself)

permissions.name: Transport orders: spm.manage
permissions.description: Create SPMs from orders, edit their lines and move them through planning, loading and delivery

permissions.name: Transport orders: spm.reopen
permissions.description: Re-open an SPM after delivery or change its destination (with a reason)

permissions.name: Vendor fleet: vendor.fleet.verify
permissions.description: Verify the vehicles, drivers and documents that vendors register

permissions.name: Vendor portal: vendor.portal
permissions.description: Use the vendor portal (requires a vendor-bound membership)

permissions.name: Commercial: vendor.portal.provision
permissions.description: Provision vendor portal accounts
